T: McLovin is buying. Everyone is eating.
D: Two high school best friends spend one long night trying to get supplies for a party.
P: Serve the mains when they finally make it to Jules's party.
S: Slow caramelized onion dip with sour cream and chives, ridged potato chips
Brown onions cooked slowly in butter for 40 minutes until deep and jammy, cooled, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives. Thick ridged potato chips.
the shop where McLovin shows his fake ID

Pretzels, cheese crackers and peanuts baked in Worcestershire garlic butter until toasty and crunchy, cooled with chocolate buttons tossed through. Melt 80g butter with 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp garlic powder and half a tsp smoked paprika. Toss with 150g pretzels, 150g cheese crackers and 150g roasted peanuts. Spread on a tray and bake at 150C for 30 minutes, stirring twice. Cool completely, then mix through 100g chocolate buttons.
Warm cake doughnuts, some glazed and some rolled in cinnamon sugar
Cake doughnuts warmed at 160C for 2 minutes, dipped in a glaze of icing sugar, milk and vanilla, half of them dusted in cinnamon sugar instead.
M: Jules's party pepperoni hot honey pizza
a slice standing up at Jules's party

Thin crisp base with garlicky crushed tomato, mozzarella and cupped pepperoni, baked very hot and finished with chilli honey and fresh basil. Heat the oven to its highest setting with a tray or steel inside for 30 minutes. Mix 400g crushed tomatoes with a crushed garlic clove, oregano and salt. Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases, spread with sauce and top with 250g mozzarella and 120g pepperoni. Bake each for 7 minutes. Warm 3 tbsp honey with half a tsp chilli flakes and drizzle over with torn basil.
Eggs, bacon, potato and cheddar rolled in flour tortillas with salsa
Big tortillas filled with scrambled egg, crisp bacon, potato and cheddar, rolled and toasted in the pan.
W: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies with a soft middle
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar until glossy, flour and cocoa folded in, baked at 170C for 25 minutes so the middle stays fudgy.
K: Cherry syrup and vanilla ice cream with cold cola poured over

Cold cola poured over vanilla ice cream and homemade cherry syrup until it foams over, finished with a maraschino cherry and a straw. Simmer 200g frozen pitted cherries with 80g sugar and 60ml water for 8 minutes, mash and strain. Put 2 tbsp cherry syrup and a scoop of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Slowly pour 250ml cold cola down the side so it foams up. Top with a maraschino cherry and serve with a spoon and straw.

s.note: Slow caramelized onion dip with sour cream and chives, ridged potato chips
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter for 40 minutes until deep and jammy, then cool and chop. Fold into 200g sour cream and 100g cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives. Serve with a big bag of ridged potato chips.

s.note: Warm cake doughnuts, some glazed and some rolled in cinnamon sugar
s.how: Warm 8 cake doughnuts at 160C for 2 minutes. Dip four in a glaze of 150g icing sugar, 2 tbsp milk and vanilla. Toss the rest in sugar mixed with cinnamon. Hand them out like the cops are in on it.

m.note: Eggs, bacon, potato and cheddar rolled in flour tortillas with salsa
m.how: Scramble 8 eggs in 20g butter. Fry 200g diced bacon and 2 diced potatoes until crisp. Warm 4 large tortillas, fill with the eggs, bacon, potato, 100g grated cheddar and a spoon of salsa, then roll tightly and toast seam-side down in a dry pan.

w.note: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies with a soft middle
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 3 eggs with 250g sugar until glossy, fold in the chocolate, 80g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes so the middle stays fudgy. Cool before cutting.

d.note: Cherry syrup and vanilla ice cream with cold cola poured over
d.how: Simmer 200g frozen pitted cherries with 80g sugar and 60ml water for 8 minutes, mash and strain. Put 2 tbsp cherry syrup and a scoop of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Slowly pour 250ml cold cola down the side so it foams up. Top with a maraschino cherry and serve with a spoon and straw.
